0022600158.text: The Cavaliers (3-2) host the Thunder (4-1) in the 7th game of Cleveland's season, with the Cavaliers 3-0 at home but 0-2 on the road and coming off a loss, and Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain. Oklahoma City has won four of its last five games and sits 4th in the West, but it is also missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). In the 2025-26 season Cleveland lost both meetings, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
